failure: Linear MIRROR on both axes of a 1x1 texture returned 0.0637817383 instead of 0.07421875 at coordinate (-1.875,-1.875), row 231 lane 1.
cause: The first linear tap can be -period-1. Adding one period to a negative tap leaves that boundary negative; the old implementation could send an out-of-range Gather index.
fix_under_test: Add two periods for negative taps, then reduce once. Extended tests add coordinates immediately inside the negative and positive two-unit seams.
